analyst_view.overall: Two sides near the bottom on 1 point each: Pafos are 31st and Midtjylland 34th after a 6-1 home defeat to Ajax on 5 Nov, so both need a win to stay in the play-off race. Midtjylland won 2-0 at Brondby on Monday to lead the Danish league by three points and play the title clash at Copenhagen on Sunday, so Mike Tullberg has a strong reason to rotate in Cyprus; Kjell Watjen is banned after his red against Ajax and Ousmane Diao went off at Brondby with a foot problem (both on the numbers' list, along with keeper Bakker, Castillo and four day-to-day players). Pafos lose Lele to a ban (counted, about -19% for their goals) and winger Ngamaleu to a serious injury that the numbers do not know about, with Biel doubtful, though Goldar and Pepe are back. Referee Ishmael Barbara's low card rate is already in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals, already with Pafos cut about 19% for Lele's ban. I lean lower to about 2.4: Pafos have also lost Ngamaleu to a serious injury with Biel doubtful, and Midtjylland, wedged between Brondby and the title clash at Copenhagen, are likely to rotate; neither is in the numbers. Both teams' leaky recent defending is already in the momentum figures.

corners.text: The numbers expect 10.4 corners and already add for both sides' high recent corner counts (Pafos conceded 52 in six). A rotated Midtjylland might sit deeper and give Pafos more of the ball, which could cut both ways for corners, so I stay at about 10.4.

cards.text: The numbers expect 3.4 cards and already cut both sides about 9-10% for low recent card counts and referee Ishmael Barbara's 3.3 a game. Both teams had a player sent off last time in Europe (Lele, Watjen), which shows up in the bans rather than in a hotter match, so I stay at about 3.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.9 shots, 12.6 for Midtjylland. I trim to about 26.8 since a rotated away side with Copenhagen on Sunday is likely to shoot less, and Pafos are without Ngamaleu, one of their wide outlets; neither the schedule nor his injury is in the numbers.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.8 shots on target, already lifted for Pafos's sharp recent shooting (26 on target in six) and cut for Lele's ban. I lean lower to about 9.3 for likely Midtjylland rotation and Ngamaleu's injury on top of Lele's absence.
